register_model: register a new model class to the registry using the @registry.register_model decorator with a unique name
register_task: register a new task class to the registry using the @registry.register_task decorator with a unique name
register_dataset: register a new dataset class to the registry using the @registry.register_dataset decorator with a unique name
get_model_class: get a registered model class from the registry by name or fully qualified import path
register_and_get_state: register a key-value pair in the registry state and retrieve it later using registry.get
